models.title: Gorgehold Scout (Gorgehold Survivor Gallery and Operations)
models.description: MakeHuman CC0 anatomical foundation, eyes and source rig weights with original fitted clothing, material treatment and authored motion. In-place locomotion. Hidden body beneath clothing is removed. Stylized third-person character; no AA close-up or arbitrary equipment hand-fit certification. Calibration handle is not included.

models.title: Grey wolf (Realistic Wild Animals HD)
models.description: Grey wolf standing alert with pricked ears, a dense neck ruff and the long straight legs of a courser, about 0.8 m at the shoulder. Premium-tier smooth-shaded anatomy with a fine procedural hide and coat grain; markings are modelled geometry, not decals. Dimensions 0.36 x 1.03 x 2.09 metres. Metres, +Y up, +Z forward, lowest point at y=0, pivot on the footprint centre. Static posed study; no rig, animation, collision or navigation data.

models.title: Jungle Canopy Tree (Jungle Temple and Stone City)
models.description: Free 3D model of an emergent rainforest canopy tree: a 14 m trunk breaking out above the forest with a wide crown and two long lianas. Dimensions 10.70 by 16.06 by 9.96 m (X by Y by Z). Metre units, +Y up, +Z front, origin on the footprint at ground level. The tallest piece in the pack; use it to close the skyline behind a ruin. Solid geometry throughout, no alpha cards and no wind. Stone city palette: weathered pale limestone and darker andesite, red ochre stucco, moss stain, two greens of rainforest foliage, bark, cut timber, fibre rope, sun bleached canvas, black obsidian and jade green water. Static geometry; no rig, animation, collision or navigation data.

models.title: Fallen Mossy Log 5.4 m (FPS Survival Forest Outpost)
models.description: A 5.4 m fallen conifer lying on the forest floor: a tapered trunk with one sawn end, six broken branch stubs, seven patches of moss along the upper surface and four slabs of shed bark on the ground beside it. It reads as cover and as a firewood source. Dimensions 5.42 × 0.98 × 1.34 m (X × Y × Z). Metre units, +Y up, +Z front; origin on the ground at the footprint centre unless stated.
